The **Text** group of the node palette has 14 nodes: 11 run, 3 cannot run yet or are deprecated.

| Node | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Count Vectorizer](../text/count-vectorizer.md) | Runs | Bag-of-words vectorization. |
| [NER](../text/ner.md) | Can't run yet | Named Entity Recognition. |
| [NER Sequence Builder](../text/ner-sequence-builder.md) | Runs | Build token-level sequence samples for NER. |
| [NER Tag Vocabulary](../text/ner-tag-vocabulary.md) | Runs | Build deterministic BIO tag vocabulary for sequence tagging. |
| [Padding (legacy)](../text/padding-legacy.md) | Deprecated | Legacy folded config node; use Tokenizer padding settings for new graphs. |
| [POS Vocabulary](../text/pos-vocabulary.md) | Runs | Build deterministic POS id vocabulary for sequence tagging. |
| [Sentiment Analysis](../text/sentiment-analysis.md) | Runs | Sentiment analysis. |
| [Sequence Tag Output](../text/sequence-tag-output.md) | Runs | Declare token-level sequence tagger output and decode metadata. |
| [Text Clean](../text/text-clean.md) | Runs | Clean one text column; optional parsed HTML preserves source text, entities and paragraph boundaries. |
| [TF-IDF](../text/tf-idf.md) | Runs | TF-IDF text vectorization. |
| [Token Vocabulary](../text/token-vocabulary.md) | Runs | Build deterministic token id vocabulary for sequence tagging. |
| [Tokenizer](../text/tokenizer.md) | Runs | Tokenize text, build/load vocabulary, and pad/truncate sequences. |
| [Vocabulary (legacy)](../text/vocabulary-legacy.md) | Deprecated | Legacy folded config node; use Tokenizer vocabulary settings for new graphs. |
| [Word Embeddings](../text/word-embeddings.md) | Runs | Word vectors from a pretrained file or trained with word2vec, GloVe or fastText. |
